India vs Australia, 4th T20I Live Score And Latest Updates: Thrilling five-match T20I series between India and Australia is perfectly poised at 1-1 as both sides move to the Carrara Oval in Gold Coast for the pivotal 4th T20I. Following a washout in the first game, Australia took a narrow lead in the second, only for India's young brigade, powered by a superb all-round effort including Washington Sundar's late heroics, to bounce back in the third. This match is crucial—a win here not only guarantees the series won't be lost but also provides a vital surge of momentum ahead of the final showdown.
